title: decompose connector init patterns and add values transform for private installer upgrades
author: Evelyn Park
body: Motivation: upgrades from older private-installer chart versions often hit subtle breakages when tenants use customized connector init hooks or rely on legacy values. This PR splits connector/init job patterns into composable templates, introduces a values-transform shim to map legacy top-level fields into the new structured values shape, and adds guardrails for airgapped and dry-run flows. Summary of changes: 1) templates/_connector-init.tpl: extracted connector init job template that supports phased waves, leader election, and an optional quota-prober sidecar; 2) templates/_values-transform.yaml: a helm helper that normalizes legacy values at render-time and emits warnings when deprecated fields are used; 3) values.schema.json: extended schema with new connectors.* objects, initWave sequencing, and explicit backoff/retry settings; 4) templates/tenant-init-job.yaml: uses the new connector template and supports per-tenant concurrency and namespace-scoped images; 5) chart-tests and a lightweight test harness to exercise values transform for common upgrade patterns; 6) docs/upgrade-notes.md: guidance and example migration mapping. Checklist: - [x] Implement templating helpers with minimal behavioral changes - [x] Add values schema and JSON-schema-driven validation - [x] Provide migration shim and automated values mapping - [x] Add unit/helm-template tests for typical edge-cases (airgap, missing connectors) - [x] Manual dry-run upgrade verified on a 3-tenant dev cluster Breaking considerations and upgrade path: the old flat keys are still accepted but will be logged as deprecated; the values-transform helper attempts to map them to the new connectors.* shape during render to avoid requiring manual edits for most customers. For advanced customizations, migration examples are included in docs/upgrade-notes.md. Why this is different from previous init-hook work: previous PRs adjusted hook sequencing and timeouts; this change focuses on schema evolution and safe automated mapping so Private customers can upgrade without hand-editing tenant overlays. Risks and mitigations: mapping may not cover bespoke customer overlays; added explicit warnings and a dry-run check that fails helm schema validation in CI if unmapped deprecated keys are present. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut a 0.0.x chart patch with the migration shim enabled by default behind a feature flag (values.migration.enable=true), and communicate via release notes and in-console upgrade hints.
commits: refactor(templates): extract connector init job into _connector-init.tpl
feat(values): add values-transform helper and deprecation warnings
chore(schema): extend values.schema.json with connectors.* and initWave fields
test(helm): add template tests and migration fixtures
docs: add upgrade-notes.md with example mappings
review_thread: Ravi Patel (reviewer): The helper looks sensible but please add a test that covers legacy values.namespace -> connectors.namespace mapping.
Evelyn Park (author): Added migration fixture and updated helm test to cover namespace mapping (see commit test(helm)).
Maya Chen (reviewer): Can we avoid emitting warnings during normal dry-run? They make templating noisy in automation. Requesting an opt-out flag.
Evelyn Park (author): Added values.migration.emitWarnings (default true) and documented it. CI will still run strict validation when the feature flag is enabled.
Antoine Leroy (reviewer): I ran the chart against our on-prem airgapped image mirror; the leader election default caused a race in tiny clusters, suggested lowering leaderLeaseDuration default.
Evelyn Park (author): Adjusted leaderLeaseDuration default and added a note in values.schema.json; ran the canary upgrade in staging and validated no regression.
Ravi Patel (approver): Approving after the added tests and the schema update. Good to squash-merge.
merge_outcome: merged via squash (merge commit: 'squash: decompose connector init templates and add values transform for safe upgrades')
release_notes: Introduce connectors.* structured values and initWave sequencing for tenant init jobs
Add values-transform shim to map legacy flat keys to new schema during render
New helm helper templates for connector init jobs, enabling per-tenant concurrency and airgap-friendly image overrides
Migration opt-in flag values.migration.enable (default: true) and emitWarnings toggle for automation
